notes.title: A new visual novel in the style of Pandemic Love
notes.notes:
If you liked Pandemic Love you might be interested in my latest release: Where the Music Dies. It's a dark visual novel about a person handling the sorrow of losing a friend by going to an old music festival and interacting with the people there, trying to grow.

You could call it a companion piece to Pandemic Love that shares some gameplay elements, graphical style, as well as themes. If you think you would find that interesting, you can always [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2483250/Where_the_Music_Dies/]check it out here on Steam.[/url]

notes.title: Patch fixes for Pandemic Love (v. 1.1g.)
notes.notes:
First. Thanks to everyone that has written to me here on Steam or on other platforms. The respons to this little game has been overwhelming. I don't really know what to write...

Second. Pandemic Love has been updated to v. 1.1g.
[list]
[*]Fixed a game breaking bug during one of the paths in the later part of the game.
[*]Fixed a few spelling errors.
[*]Made minor changes to some of the dialogues to make them flow better.
[*]No gameplay changes, no story changes.
[/list]
